meta.title: 莫斯科游泳教学：蝶泳手臂与换气问题
meta.title_en: Moscow Swim Lesson: Butterfly Arms and Breathing

scenes.title_cn: 反面案例：错误的手臂与呼吸
scenes.title_en: The Wrong Way: Arms and Breathing
scenes.context: 开场展示反面案例：错误的手臂与呼吸，配俄语感叹词「ФУ!」（不行/糟糕）。教练指出常见的蝶泳错误示范。
sentences: 开场是反面案例：错误的手臂与呼吸。
The opening is a counter-example: wrong arms and breathing.
counter-example（反面案例）
配俄语感叹词「ФУ!」，表示不行、糟糕。
It comes with the Russian exclamation “ФУ!”—no, ugh.
exclamation（感叹词）
scenes.speak: The opening is a counter-example: wrong arms and breathing. It comes with the Russian exclamation “ФУ!”—no, ugh.

scenes.context: 教练带学员做岸上模拟：推水发力练习。通过陆上动作感受蝶泳推水的发力方式，再带入水中。
sentences: 先在岸上模拟，练习推水发力。
First simulate on deck: the pulling-power drill.
simulate（模拟）
找到发力感，再带入水中。
Find the power feel, then take it into the water.
power feel（发力感）
scenes.speak: First simulate on deck: the pulling-power drill. Find the power feel, then take it into the water.

scenes.title_cn: 换气瞬间：推水同步打腿
scenes.title_en: The Breath Moment: Sync Kick With Pull
scenes.context: 水中实拍换气瞬间，字幕提示「注意推水同步打腿」。蝶泳换气要配合推水和打腿的节奏，形成整体动作。
sentences: 换气瞬间要同步打腿。
At the breath, sync the kick with the pull.
sync（同步）
推水和打腿形成整体节奏。
The pull and kick become one rhythm.
rhythm（节奏）
scenes.speak: At the breath, sync the kick with the pull. The pull and kick become one rhythm.

scenes.context: 岸上模拟正确换气姿态，字幕「推水换气保持颈肩背在一条线上」。换气时身体要像钢板一样整体转动，而不是抬头。
sentences: 推水换气时，颈肩背保持一条线。
During the pull and breath, keep neck, shoulders and back in one line.
in one line（一条线）
像钢板一样整体转动，不要抬头。
Rotate as one plank—never lift the chin.
plank（钢板）
scenes.speak: During the pull and breath, keep neck, shoulders and back in one line. Rotate as one plank—never lift the chin.

scenes.context: 岸上模拟发力技巧，教练比出数字「3」，强调推水发力的时机与力度，让换气前的最后一推更有力。
sentences: 教练比出数字「3」，强调发力时机。
The coach holds up “3” to cue the power timing.
cue（提示）
最后一推要有力，帮助身体出水。
The final push must be strong to lift the body out.
lift out（带出水面）
scenes.speak: The coach holds up “3” to cue the power timing. The final push must be strong to lift the body out.

scenes.context: 水中实拍叠加岸上示范，字幕「保持身体平直向前推进」。身体不要上下起伏太大，保持平直向前。
sentences: 保持身体平直，向前推进。
Keep the body flat and drive forward.
drive forward（向前推进）
减少上下起伏，保存体力。
Less bobbing saves your energy.
bob（起伏）
scenes.speak: Keep the body flat and drive forward. Less bobbing saves your energy.

scenes.context: 岸上模拟移臂方式，教练比出数字「4」，强调移臂要屈肘、低平，避免甩臂过直造成肩部疲劳。
sentences: 移臂方式也有讲究，比出数字「4」。
Even the recovery has a cue—the “4”.
recovery（移臂）
屈肘低平移臂，避免肩部疲劳。
Bend the elbow and stay low to spare your shoulders.
spare（省着用）
scenes.speak: Even the recovery has a cue—the “4”. Bend the elbow and stay low to spare your shoulders.

scenes.context: 字幕「肘部弯曲更有利移臂」。屈肘移臂让手更贴近水面滑行，减小空气阻力与肩膀负担，是蝶泳高效移臂的关键。
sentences: 肘部弯曲更有利于移臂。
Bending the elbow helps the recovery.
bent elbow（屈肘）
手贴近水面滑行，肩部负担更小。
Sliding low keeps the load off your shoulder.
shoulder load（肩部负担）
scenes.speak: Bending the elbow helps the recovery. Sliding low keeps the load off your shoulder.

practice: Sync the kick with the pull at the breath.
Keep neck, shoulders and back in one line.
Keep the body flat and drive forward.
Bending the elbow helps the recovery.
pitfalls: Rotating the whole body like a plank
抬头换气会让身体断成两截
推水不到位，换气就顶不上去
换气时不打腿，动作断节
shifts: 现在推水+打腿+颈肩背一条线整体转
现在比数字3和4记住发力与移臂
现在保持平直向前推进
footer_notes: 蝶泳换气口诀：推水时打腿、颈肩背成一线、身体平直推进、屈肘移臂。俄教练的三字诀：推、线、平。
